title: Transient absorption spectroscopy: a mechanistic tool for triplet sensitizers and their applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1862-1890
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00614G, Tutorial Review
Mushraf Hussain, Samana Batool, Zafar Mahmood, Nooreen Rehmat, Ahmed M. El-Zohry, Jianzhang Zhao, Mariangela Di Donato, Matthew C. T. Hartman, Katharine Moore Tibbetts
Transient absorption spectroscopy is used to study events that take place upon photoexcitation and reveal the processes such as electron transfer, energy transfer, intersystem crossing, isomerization, proton transfer, exciplex formation, etc.
